Name: guild_agent_card_revisions
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_agent_card_revisions (
    CardId TEXT NOT NULL CHECK((CardId=upper(CardId) AND length(CardId)=36 AND substr(CardId,9,1)='-' AND substr(CardId,14,1)='-' AND substr(CardId,19,1)='-' AND substr(CardId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(CardId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(CardId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND CardId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    Revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Revision > 0),
    ContentId TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK((ContentId=upper(ContentId) AND length(ContentId)=36 AND substr(ContentId,9,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,14,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,19,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(ContentId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(ContentId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND ContentId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    SourceDigest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(SourceDigest AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536),
    CreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(CardId,Revision)
);

Name: guild_agent_cards
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_agent_cards (

    AgentId TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK((AgentId=upper(AgentId) AND length(AgentId)=36 AND substr(AgentId,9,1)='-' AND substr(AgentId,14,1)='-' AND substr(AgentId,19,1)='-' AND substr(AgentId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(AgentId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(AgentId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND AgentId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    ExplicitAgentId TEXT NULL UNIQUE CHECK((ExplicitAgentId IS NULL OR (ExplicitAgentId=upper(ExplicitAgentId) AND length(ExplicitAgentId)=36 AND substr(ExplicitAgentId,9,1)='-' AND substr(ExplicitAgentId,14,1)='-' AND substr(ExplicitAgentId,19,1)='-' AND substr(ExplicitAgentId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(ExplicitAgentId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(ExplicitAgentId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND ExplicitAgentId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    SourceKindCode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(SourceKindCode BETWEEN 0 AND 3),
    SourceIdentity TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(CAST(SourceIdentity AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536),
    WorkspaceId TEXT NULL CHECK((WorkspaceId IS NULL OR (WorkspaceId=upper(WorkspaceId) AND length(WorkspaceId)=36 AND substr(WorkspaceId,9,1)='-' AND substr(WorkspaceId,14,1)='-' AND substr(WorkspaceId,19,1)='-' AND substr(WorkspaceId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(WorkspaceId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(WorkspaceId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND WorkspaceId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    PeerId TEXT NULL CHECK(PeerId IS NULL OR (length(CAST(PeerId AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536)),
    SessionId TEXT NULL CHECK((SessionId IS NULL OR (SessionId=upper(SessionId) AND length(SessionId)=36 AND substr(SessionId,9,1)='-' AND substr(SessionId,14,1)='-' AND substr(SessionId,19,1)='-' AND substr(SessionId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(SessionId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(SessionId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND SessionId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    CampaignId TEXT NULL CHECK((CampaignId IS NULL OR (CampaignId=upper(CampaignId) AND length(CampaignId)=36 AND substr(CampaignId,9,1)='-' AND substr(CampaignId,14,1)='-' AND substr(CampaignId,19,1)='-' AND substr(CampaignId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(CampaignId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(CampaignId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND CampaignId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    CurrentRevision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(CurrentRevision > 0),
    ContentId TEXT NULL CHECK((ContentId IS NULL OR (ContentId=upper(ContentId) AND length(ContentId)=36 AND substr(ContentId,9,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,14,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,19,1)='-' AND substr(ContentId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(ContentId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(ContentId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND ContentId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'))),
    Available INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Available IN(0,1)),
    ReasonCode TEXT NULL CHECK(ReasonCode IS NULL OR (length(CAST(ReasonCode AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 65536)),
    CreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    UpdatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK(SourceKindCode<>2 OR SessionId IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK(SourceKindCode=2 OR (SessionId IS NULL AND CampaignId IS NULL))
);

Name: guild_budget_accounts
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_budget_accounts (
    AccountId TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(AccountId=upper(AccountId) AND length(AccountId)=36 AND substr(AccountId,9,1)='-' AND substr(AccountId,14,1)='-' AND substr(AccountId,19,1)='-' AND substr(AccountId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(AccountId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(AccountId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND AccountId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'),
    OwnerKindCode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(OwnerKindCode)='integer' AND OwnerKindCode IN(0,1)),
    OwnerId TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(OwnerId=upper(OwnerId) AND length(OwnerId)=36 AND substr(OwnerId,9,1)='-' AND substr(OwnerId,14,1)='-' AND substr(OwnerId,19,1)='-' AND substr(OwnerId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(OwnerId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(OwnerId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND OwnerId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'),
    RootAccountId TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES guild_budget_accounts(AccountId) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED CHECK(RootAccountId=upper(RootAccountId) AND length(RootAccountId)=36 AND substr(RootAccountId,9,1)='-' AND substr(RootAccountId,14,1)='-' AND substr(RootAccountId,19,1)='-' AND substr(RootAccountId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(RootAccountId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(RootAccountId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND RootAccountId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'),
    ParentAccountId TEXT NULL REFERENCES guild_budget_accounts(AccountId) ON DELETE RESTRICT CHECK(ParentAccountId IS NULL OR (ParentAccountId=upper(ParentAccountId) AND length(ParentAccountId)=36 AND substr(ParentAccountId,9,1)='-' AND substr(ParentAccountId,14,1)='-' AND substr(ParentAccountId,19,1)='-' AND substr(ParentAccountId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(ParentAccountId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(ParentAccountId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND ParentAccountId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    UsdLimit TEXT NULL CHECK(UsdLimit IS NULL OR typeof(UsdLimit)='text'),
    TokenLimit INTEGER NULL CHECK(TokenLimit IS NULL OR (typeof(TokenLimit)='integer' AND TokenLimit>=0)),
    Closed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(typeof(Closed)='integer' AND Closed IN(0,1)),
    SettlementReceiptId TEXT NULL CHECK(SettlementReceiptId IS NULL OR (SettlementReceiptId=upper(SettlementReceiptId) AND length(SettlementReceiptId)=36 AND substr(SettlementReceiptId,9,1)='-' AND substr(SettlementReceiptId,14,1)='-' AND substr(SettlementReceiptId,19,1)='-' AND substr(SettlementReceiptId,24,1)='-' AND length(replace(SettlementReceiptId,'-',''))=32 AND replace(SettlementReceiptId,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND SettlementReceiptId<>'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')),
    Revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(Revision)='integer' AND Revision>=1),
    UNIQUE(OwnerKindCode,OwnerId),
    CHECK((ParentAccountId IS NULL AND RootAccountId=AccountId) OR (ParentAccountId IS NOT NULL AND RootAccountId<>AccountId AND ParentAccountId<>AccountId))
);

Name: guild_cohort_ledger
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_cohort_ledger (
    Id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    CohortId TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES guild_cohorts(Id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    Sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(Sequence)='integer' AND Sequence>=1),
    AuthorQuestId TEXT NULL,
    AuthorMemberId TEXT NULL,
    OperatorPrincipalId TEXT NULL,
    AuthorityCode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(AuthorityCode IN(1,2,3)),
    KindCode INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(KindCode IN(1,2,3)),
    SubjectId TEXT NULL,
    CorrectsNoteId TEXT NULL,
    ContentId TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    SessionId TEXT NULL,
    CampaignId TEXT NULL,
    Digest BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(Digest)='blob' AND length(Digest)=32),
    ByteLength INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(ByteLength)='integer' AND ByteLength BETWEEN 1 AND 65536),
    ActorKey TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(ActorKey AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    IdempotencyKey TEXT NOT NULL,
    RequestDigest BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(RequestDigest)='blob' AND length(RequestDigest)=32),
    ReceiptId TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    AcceptedRevision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(AcceptedRevision>=1),
    CreatedAtUtc TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(CohortId,Sequence),
    UNIQUE(CohortId,ActorKey,IdempotencyKey),
    CHECK((AuthorityCode=1 AND AuthorQuestId IS NULL AND AuthorMemberId IS NULL AND OperatorPrincipalId IS NOT NULL)
        OR (AuthorityCode=2 AND AuthorQuestId IS NOT NULL AND AuthorMemberId IS NULL AND OperatorPrincipalId IS NULL)
        OR (AuthorityCode=3 AND AuthorQuestId IS NOT NULL AND AuthorMemberId IS NOT NULL AND OperatorPrincipalId IS NULL)),
    CHECK((KindCode=3 AND CorrectsNoteId IS NOT NULL) OR (KindCode IN(1,2) AND CorrectsNoteId IS NULL))
);

Name: guild_cohorts
Sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_cohorts (

    RootQuestId TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES guild_quests(Id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    IssuerQuestId TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES guild_quests(Id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CampaignId TEXT NULL,

    Quorum INTEGER NULL CHECK((PolicyCode=3 AND Quorum>=1) OR (PolicyCode<>3 AND Quorum IS NULL)),
    MimeType TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(MimeType IN ('text/plain','application/json')),

Name: guild_work_offers_guard_update
Sql:
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guild_work_offers_guard_update BEFORE UPDATE ON guild_work_offers
WHEN NEW.Id IS NOT OLD.Id OR NEW.CohortId IS NOT OLD.CohortId OR NEW.IssuerQuestId IS NOT OLD.IssuerQuestId
 OR NEW.OfferSequence IS NOT OLD.OfferSequence OR NEW.SkillId IS NOT OLD.SkillId OR NEW.GoalContentId IS NOT OLD.GoalContentId
 OR NEW.RequestedGrantJson IS NOT OLD.RequestedGrantJson OR NEW.BudgetHint IS NOT OLD.BudgetHint OR NEW.MimeType IS NOT OLD.MimeType
 OR NEW.BidSequence<OLD.BidSequence OR NEW.BidSequence>OLD.BidSequence+1
 OR (NEW.BidSequence<>OLD.BidSequence AND OLD.StateCode<>1)
 OR (NEW.StateCode=OLD.StateCode AND (NEW.Revision<>OLD.Revision OR NEW.AwardId IS NOT OLD.AwardId OR NEW.QuestId IS NOT OLD.QuestId OR NEW.ClosedReason IS NOT OLD.ClosedReason))
 OR (NEW.StateCode<>OLD.StateCode AND (OLD.StateCode<>1 OR NEW.StateCode NOT IN (2,3,4) OR NEW.Revision<>OLD.Revision+1))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable work offer'); END;

Name: guild_workspace_authority_state_guard_update
guild_workspace_lease_mutations_guard_insert
Sql:
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guild_workspace_lease_mutations_guard_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON guild_workspace_lease_mutations
WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM guild_workspace_leases lease WHERE lease.Id=NEW.LeaseId
    AND lease.PrincipalId=NEW.PrincipalId AND lease.QuestId IS NEW.QuestId)
  OR (NEW.ActionCode=3 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM guild_workspace_leases lease WHERE lease.Id=NEW.LeaseId
    AND lease.PrincipalId=NEW.PrincipalId AND lease.QuestId IS NEW.QuestId
    AND lease.IdempotencyKey=NEW.IdempotencyKey AND lease.RequestDigest=NEW.RequestDigest
    AND lease.Epoch=1 AND lease.Revision=1 AND lease.StateCode=1 AND lease.InFlightMutationCount=0
    AND lease.HeartbeatAtUtc=NEW.AcceptedAtUtc))
  OR (NEW.ActionCode<>3 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM guild_workspace_leases lease WHERE lease.PrincipalId=NEW.PrincipalId
    AND lease.QuestId IS NEW.QuestId AND lease.IdempotencyKey=NEW.IdempotencyKey))
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'The Guild workspace mutation key or acquisition acceptance does not match its lease.');
END;

Name: guild_workspace_leases_guard_update
Sql:
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guild_workspace_leases_guard_update
BEFORE UPDATE ON guild_workspace_leases
WHEN NEW.Id IS NOT OLD.Id
  OR NEW.OwnerKindCode IS NOT OLD.OwnerKindCode
  OR NEW.PrincipalId IS NOT OLD.PrincipalId
  OR NEW.QuestId IS NOT OLD.QuestId
  OR NEW.RootQuestId IS NOT OLD.RootQuestId
  OR NEW.SessionId IS NOT OLD.SessionId
  OR NEW.CampaignId IS NOT OLD.CampaignId
  OR NEW.WorkspaceId IS NOT OLD.WorkspaceId
  OR NEW.InstallationGeneration IS NOT OLD.InstallationGeneration
  OR NEW.WorkspaceRoot IS NOT OLD.WorkspaceRoot
  OR NEW.IdentityJson IS NOT OLD.IdentityJson
  OR NEW.IdentityDigest IS NOT OLD.IdentityDigest
  OR NEW.EffectKindCode IS NOT OLD.EffectKindCode
  OR NEW.IdempotencyKey IS NOT OLD.IdempotencyKey
  OR NEW.RequestDigest IS NOT OLD.RequestDigest
  OR NEW.Revision<>OLD.Revision+1
  OR NEW.Epoch<OLD.Epoch
  OR NEW.Epoch>OLD.Epoch+1
  OR (NEW.HostInstanceId IS NOT OLD.HostInstanceId AND NEW.Epoch<>OLD.Epoch+1)
  OR (OLD.StateCode=3 AND NEW.StateCode<>3)
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Guild workspace lease authority and identity are immutable.');
END;
